zh: 先算出完全不交换时的强度作为基线；交换相邻的 i 和 i+1 之后，强度的变化只与这两个元素有关，和其他交换互不影响。
交换 i 与 i+1 带来的增益是 arr[i]−arr[i+1]，为负时不如不换。每个元素最多参与一次交换，选中的交换对不能共用元素，于是问题变成在一条链上选一些互不相交的相邻对，使增益之和最大。
从右往左做 DP：dp[i] 表示只考虑从 i 开始的元素时能得到的最大增益，取 dp[i+1]（i 不参与交换）与 dp[i+2] 加上 arr[i]−arr[i+1] 和 0 中的较大者（交换 i 与 i+1）两者中的较大值。答案为基线 Σ arr[i]×(i+1) 加上 dp[0]，需要 64 位整数。
en: First compute the strength with no swaps as a baseline; swapping neighbors i and i+1 changes the strength by an amount that depends only on those two elements and not on any other swap.

Swapping i and i+1 gains arr[i]−arr[i+1], and a negative gain is worse than not swapping. Each element takes part in at most one swap, so the chosen pairs cannot share elements: pick disjoint adjacent pairs along a line to maximize the total gain.

Run a DP from right to left: dp[i] is the best gain using only the elements from i on, the larger of dp[i+1] (i is not swapped) and dp[i+2] plus the larger of arr[i]−arr[i+1] and 0 (swap i and i+1). The answer is the baseline Σ arr[i]×(i+1) plus dp[0], which needs 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use the contribution without any swaps as the baseline. Swapping i and i+1 gains arr[i]−arr[i+1]; use a linear DP to take the better of making an adjacent swap or skipping.

## Proof of correctness

All operations form a matching of disjoint adjacent edges. If i and i+1 are swapped, the change in the weighted sum is (i+1)arr[i+1]+(i+2)arr[i]−(i+1)arr[i]−(i+2)arr[i+1]=arr[i]−arr[i+1]. For each i, the optimal choice either skips i or takes the edge (i,i+1) and skips the next edge, and the recurrence covers every valid plan.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
